  policy modifications outlined by the Long Beach Ethics Commission to enhance
  transparency, accountability, and public trust, and staff recommendations

  review as necessary to ensure the final recommendations and draft ordinance
  language are consistent with the City Charter, State law, City policies, rules, and

  considerations as determined by City staff;

  ordinance framework key amendments to the City’s Lobbyist Ordinance (LBMC

  City’s decision-making processes, taking into account the recommendations
  provided by the Long Beach Ethics Commission; and
